author: Arri Woodhouse
title: CMPD Bomb Squad called to northwest Charlotte business with "quantity of dynamite" on the property - NewsBreak
text:
By Arri Woodhouse ,
3 hours ago
CHARLOTTE, N.C. ( QUEEN CITY NEWS ) — Charlotte-Mecklenburg Police Department’s Bomb Squad is responding to a business in northwest Charlotte that has a “quantity of dynamite” on the property.
Police are on the scene in the 6800 block of Brookshire Boulevard.
Officials say the business routinely uses dynamite for their operations, but the condition of some of the items “necessitated expert intervention.”
Technicians are currently on scene using specialized equipment to deem the items safe.
Motorists should expect temporary road closures on Brookshire at Old Plank Road and Fred D. Alexander Boulevard.
As a precaution, some voluntary evacuations are in place, but police say there is no immediate threat to the community.
Queen City News is headed to the scene and are working to learn more.
